item.title: Refactor order status to OrderStatus enum
item.brief:
Refactor the orders crate's order status from String to a proper enum, preserving observable behavior exactly.

Requirements:
- Add src/status.rs with pub enum OrderStatus { Pending, Paid, Shipped, Cancelled }, deriving at least Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash.
- OrderStatus::as_str(self) -> &'static str returns lowercase names ("pending", "paid", "shipped", "cancelled"); Display prints the same.
- Implement FromStr for OrderStatus with type Err = ParseStatusError, a public error type implementing std::error::Error, whose message names the rejected input.
- OrderStatus::can_transition_to(self, next: OrderStatus) -> bool encodes exactly: pending -> paid, pending -> cancelled, paid -> shipped, paid -> cancelled; no other transitions.
- Order::status becomes OrderStatus; re-export OrderStatus and ParseStatusError from crate root.
- Use the enum everywhere, so status string literals appear only in src/status.rs.
- Preserve observable behaviour: errors, report output and ordering, and parsing exactly as before.
- Run cargo test and ensure it passes.
- Commit the work.

Acceptance criteria: compile and cargo test pass; all relevant code uses OrderStatus; status strings exist only in src/status.rs; prior parsing/error/report behavior and ordering are preserved; change is committed in the item branch/worktree.

stages.summary:
Baseline and characterization complete for the OrderStatus refactor. Structural goal: replace String order statuses with public OrderStatus { Pending, Paid, Shipped, Cancelled }, preserving existing observable behavior; the brief explicitly requires a typed status and parser/error API, with no allowed behavior changes to existing operations, errors, reports, ordering, or parsing. Original baseline is f7a188c91a811dfadb63fa8b5aafab56cfe160cd (HEAD at task start; required diff range was empty). Added and committed only characterization tests as 0abdc5343739268d2415710bd302ccaf470d80d9 (`test: characterize order status behavior`); worktree is clean on the assigned branch.

Checks: before edits, `CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/home/mengsig/.local/share/archon-bench/full-165-Q4J35ZNK/r-dwsb1bl5/archon-bench/work/20261125T011222Z/69babdd4df669b4a16042c8d/.archon/data/cache/refactor-order-status/items/qi_01M88EVKX493KWBA4913DWV8FG/cargo-target cargo test` passed (3 integration tests, no unit/doc tests). After adding characterization tests, the same command passed (6 integration tests). Two initial runs of the new assertions failed because the assertions incorrectly assumed trimming of individual comma fields; expectations were corrected to capture actual behavior (whole-line trim only, numeric fields parsed without per-field trim). No README, Makefile, CI, lint, format, or other check configuration was present; cargo test is the documented-by-manifest available check. No production files were changed.

Public surface inventory: crate root exports Order; `Order` exposes public id/customer/total_cents/status fields and `new`, `is_open`, `cancel`; billing exposes `pay` and `outstanding_cents`; shipping exposes `ship` and `ready_to_ship`; report exposes `status_counts`, `to_line`, `from_line`. No CLI or separate wire/file format exists; report lines are `id,customer,total_cents,status`. Preserve lifecycle eligibility, exact failure strings (`cannot be paid/shipped/cancelled: it is …`), status count lexical sorting, input ordering of ready-to-ship IDs, report line field order, parser field-count/id/total/unknown-status errors, whole-line trimming, and round-trip behavior. The added tests pin cancellation failures in cancelled and shipped states; report parser malformed field counts, bad id/total, unknown status spelling, and whitespace behavior; count lexical order and serialized status. Existing tests pin normal lifecycle, payment/shipping refusal, report round trip, counts, outstanding total, and shipping ID order. Remaining coverage gaps for the refactorer: no exhaustive tests for every illegal transition/state combination, empty fields, or every valid status round-trip; preserve those contracts by inspection. Feedback was empty.
